_comment: Manual review of the v2b final run. Each entry applies ONLY if the service returns exactly 'reviewed_answer' again; a new answer is left unreviewed and flagged in notes. All 15 answers were read in full; entries below are the ones with notes.

2.notes: Correct. Grounding check (v2b) trimmed an unsupported phrase before returning: the model wrote 'sick days and study days are separate' in one repeat run; in this final run the answer came back clean. This is the question that failed in v1.
2.reviewed_answer: You can carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year, and you must use them by 31 March or they are lost. Any days above the 5-day limit are lost at the end of the year unless the Head of People approves an exception in writing.

5.notes: Correct. The grounding check trimmed 'through the Travel Desk' from the first sentence (the policy says trips are booked through the Travel Desk, not requested there) and kept the 21-day rule.
5.reviewed_answer: International travel must be requested at least 21 days before departure. If you request later than that, the request may be refused or may need Director approval.

11.notes: Correct. Retrieval weak spot remains: the approvals section (05#3) ranks only 5th of 6 retrieved chunks; with TOP_K below 5 this question would lose its second document.
11.reviewed_answer: Yes. NGN 70,000 per night is within the domestic hotel limit of NGN 80,000 per night. Because the amount is above NGN 50,000, your claim needs approval from both your line manager and Finance.
